description: This file defines a mock class 'ControllerMock' for the 'IController' interface used in IPC communication within the Rialto project. It uses Google Mock to facilitate unit testing by mocking the behavior of the IPC controller.

classes.name: ControllerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IController interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: ControllerMock
methods.description: Default constructor for the mock class.

methods.name: ~ControllerMock
methods.description: Default destructor for the mock class.

methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve the client object.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Mocks the method to reset the controller state.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Mocks the method to check if the controller has failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve error text.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Mocks the method to initiate cancellation.

methods.name: SetFailed

methods.name: IsCanceled
